correctness.rationale: Uniform deletion of a fixed leaf establishes the finite covariance identity. The path forest extension count gives the exact alternating-distance formula for the root parity mean. Finite testing is not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: Connects natural local leaf count and global root-parity class in random Cayley trees, motivated by Contat’s parity statistics and established leaf local limits. Exact finite covariance reduction and an unexpectedly nonzero second-order constant 1/(8e) answer a natural joint fluctuation question not determined by the separate marginals. The exact bipartite conditional law aids interpretation; neither known encoding nor routine single-leaf probability is claimed novel.
